title: Route Duel
core_verb: Choose an attack each turn to reduce the opposing creature's health to zero.
fantasy: A creature trainer crosses a short route and challenges another trainer to a one-on-one creature battle.
fail_state: Your creature's health reaches zero, reducing your remaining party count from one to zero.
win_state: The opponent creature's health reaches zero, reducing the opponent party count from one to zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: The opposing trainer's only creature; it attacks on alternating turns and can reduce your party to zero.
A single route pickup that restores 40 health to your creature when used during the battle.
The route-end goal object; contact starts the one-on-one battle that must be won.

notes: Pokémon's open-ended exploration, collection, trading, and multiplayer battles are reduced to one short walkable route, one optional healing-item pickup, and one scripted single-player battle with one creature per party. Victory occurs only when the opponent party reaches zero; failure occurs when the player party reaches zero.

open_questions: The notes mention a short walkable route and optional healing pickup, but scene.description specifies a fixed encounter. Resolve whether exploration is included before choosing capabilities; do not silently drop either requirement.

scene.description: A sunlit forest clearing with a dirt path, two trainers facing each other across a patch of trampled grass, tall trees forming a natural arena wall. Nothing is traversed: the encounter resolves from these two fixed positions, so the space is a backdrop rather than a layout.
